le farine che utilizziamo provengono da: The flours we use come from a small mill at km 0 of the Bare Murgia. The base dough is prepared with organic flour type 1, microfiltered water, integral salt of the Trapani Pond (natural reserve WWF), very little yeast of beer and extra virgin organic olive oil of the Bari Murgia. Our flours are 100% natural, non-industrial and free of chemical additives, such as enzymes or improvers. The tomato is 100% Italian, seasoned with fresh basil. We also use dairy products and mozzarella at km 0, produced with serum graft, according to the dairy tradition of the Murgia barese.
